efficiency_changes: Optional personal vocabulary is off by default; saved terms survive disabling it. Both capture and connection checks use the opt-in policy.
Enabled vocabulary uses native literal keywords, with duplicate and invalid-entry removal. No history or automatic project word list is added.
Cleanup remains gpt-6-luna, uses shorter instructions, sets reasoning.effort=none, and retains complete recognized input.
Conservative UTF-8-based output headroom within the existing 2048-token cap; unused output allowance is not billed.
Per-recording bounded LRU reuses only validated identical chunk results with matching mode/filler settings. Source repetition is preserved.
Memo instances are replaced at recording start, finalization and cancel; no disk or cross-recording cache.
